v.s: Lylia sends out Gloom with a shockwave, dealing 250( +100% Total Magic Power) (Magic Damage) to enemies in a line and slowing them by 30% for 1.5s.\nIf Gloom touches Shadow Energy, he will devour and detonate it.

Lylia releases an attack wave ahead, dealing Magic Damage to enemies on the path and slowing them down. Gloom will hitch a ride on Magic Shockwave. If Gloom touches Shadow Energy, he will devour it and immediately detonate the energy.

Lylia condenses Shadow Energy at the target location, dealing 90( +50% Total Magic Power) (Magic Damage) to enemies hit and slowing them by 80%.
Shadow Energy can be detonated by Gloom's devour, dealing 220( +100% Total Magic Power) (Magic Damage) to the enemies nearby. Each Gloom upgrade increases the detonation damage by 30%, up to 120%.
A max level Gloom will restore 50% of Shadow Energy's Recharge Time when it hits an enemy hero.
Lylia starts with the Shadow Energy skill.

Lylia condenses Shadow Energy to the designated area, dealing Magic Damage to enemies nearby and slowing them down. After Gloom devours Shadow Energy, he will detonate the energy and deal Magic Damage to enemies nearby. Each time Gloom upgrades himself, the damage dealt by Shadow Energy will be increased. Lylia was born to have the ability to use Shadow Energy.
Lylia returns to the Black Shoes' location 4s ago and restores her HP and Mana to the previous state, and an extra 10% Max HP. She also gains 20% extra Movement Speed for 2s.
Lylia immediately returns to the position where the Black Shoe was 4s ago and stacks max times to use Shadow Energy, regenerating a certain amount of HP and increasing her Movement Speed.

Lylia gets power from Gloom, increasing her Movement Speed by 15%. Each Gloom upgrade further increases this bonus by 5%.\nGloom gains an upgrade every time he devours Shadow Energy, up to 5 times. Gloom upgrade increases the detonation damage of Shadow Energy.

Lylia gets power from Gloom, increasing her Movement Speed. Each time Gloom levels up, she will increase extra Movement Speed. Gloom will increase his levels by devouring Shadow Energy. Up to 5. The higher his level is, the more damage he can deal.
Unique Passive - Mana Spring: Regenerates 15% Max Mana every 10s.
Unique Passive - Ice Bound: When a skill deals damage to an enemy hero, it will also slow them by 10% for 2s (stacks up to 3 times). This effect has a 1s cooldown.
Unique Passive - Magic: Dealing Magic Damage to enemy heroes will reduce their Magic Defense by 3-7 (scales with level) for 2s. Stacks up to 3 times.
Unique Passive - Scorch: Burn targets for 3s, dealing Magic Damage equal to 1.5% of the target's Max HP per second.
Unique Passive - Spellbreaker: When attacking an enemy, gains 0.1% extra Magic Penetration for each point of the enemy's Magic Defense, capped at 20%.
